test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '5'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/697d92011855e7c80b6ddcc25fdb508c56d01ac9d8a31a66f4d7fcc89271edd8.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/697d92011855e7c80b6ddcc25fdb508c56d01ac9d8a31a66f4d7fcc89271edd8.png] 

Common number in both the dices = 5

Start with common number 5 moving clockwise.

Opposite letters:

4 ⇒ 3 

6 ⇒ 1

**5 ⇒ 2 **

Hence, **'2' is the opposite of 5**.
